in_marathi.name: Janaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rooted in Sanskrit, Janaan signifies 'giver', 'donor' or 'supplier'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit term 'jan', meaning 'people'. The name Janaan is often used for boys and signifies a generous and selfless individual.
